The Credit Agreement also contains, for the benefit of the Revolving Facility only, covenants to maintain a maximum total leverage ratio and a minimum net interest coverage ratio.

parsed.notes: The filing names the covenants: a maximum total leverage ratio and a minimum net interest coverage ratio, both for the Revolving Facility only. It states compliance as of 2026-09-26 but gives no actual values or thresholds. Leverage-based pricing grids for margins and commitment fees were excluded, as was the first lien leverage ratio used for excess cash flow sweeps.
